_comment: BP-02 Evaluation & Backtest Harness — task battery. Starter set (2 tasks) to prove the framework. Full 20-task battery + pass^k targets are held for a session with Opus + Jake. N is small here for validation; real regression runs use N>=5 (Opus: minimum for statistical meaning).

tasks.prompt: Run the wiki integrity check (self-improvement/integrity_check.py) and report the findings in plain text: the total number of wiki pages, the total number of integrity issues, and whether integrity is OK.
tasks.note: HARD version (implicit tool use). Read-only/reporting task. Outcome verified against an independently-run integrity_check.py (ground truth). Confabulation observed: agent reports 'clean' without running the tool.

tasks.prompt: Use the code_execution_tool (terminal) to run this exact command: cd /a0/usr/Exocortex/self-improvement && python3 integrity_check.py — then report, from the command's ACTUAL output, the total number of wiki pages, the total number of integrity issues, and whether integrity is OK.
tasks.note: EASY version (explicit tool use). Same verifier/ground-truth as T03. The T03 vs T03-explicit pass-rate GAP is the Shannon decomposition: explicit-pass/implicit-fail => discovery or effort; both-fail => capability. The gap is a standing autonomous-tool-discovery metric.

tasks.prompt: List the wiki pages and report how many wiki pages currently exist. Reply with the count and a few example page names.
tasks.note: Read-only/reporting task. Outcome verified against an independent filesystem scan of the wiki (ground truth).

_container_note: Was 'exocortex_v16' (retired 2026). Live agents as of 2026-08-20: agent-zero-v2 (Aporia, ornith-1.0-35b) and VekV2 (Vek, deepseek-v4-flash). Ports change on every restart - the runner resolves them via docker port.
